title: Glowing red metal found in a yard under a UFO

tellings.quote: world, but he called me and he drives up in his yard and there's this red piece of glowing he sees this thing over his house and it goes away when he drives up, but there's a piece of red glowing metal in the yard.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has many encounters with UFOs, retells what another man told him in the 1990s in Zanesville, Ohio. According to that man, he saw something hovering over his house, it went away as he drove up, and a piece of glowing red metal was left in his yard. If true, it would be a physical piece left behind by an unknown craft.
